# @ackplus/nest-crud

> CRUD route generator for NestJS + TypeORM: `@Crud()` on a controller plus a `CrudService<T>` subclass. Client query builders: `@ackplus/nest-crud-request` (JS/TS) and `nest_crud_request` (Dart).

AI assistants: read the skill first — it is the short, scenario-based guide to using this package correctly.

- [Skill (start here)](https://ack-solutions.github.io/nest-crud/skill.md)
